Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Uses Dropbox's Gil-input callbacks, enters each amount once and waits for settlement before pressing Trade. Prevents repeated input requests; adds delayed-dialog and cancellation regression tests.
